run_siamese_collator: run the siamese_collator function to collate a batch of image data and labels for the Jigsaw approach
test_siamese_collator: test the siamese_collator function with a batch of image tensors and integer labels
review_siamese_collator: review the siamese_collator function that stacks and reshapes image data from multiple siamese towers
summarize_siamese_collator: summarize the siamese_collator function that transforms per-sample data into a flattened batch tensor
refactor_siamese_collator: refactor the siamese_collator function to support variable-length label tensors across siamese towers
